planets.name: K2-102 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-102 with a 9.92-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-102 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-102. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
